description: PL.core-dock-operations-register. GET /api/v1/worlds/{worldId}/export/ir/summary: a world's IR counts and sizes without the document, called by Unreal's served-worlds list and Create World's finished page. The row publishes its one query parameter, engine (optional). requestCases: what a dock asks for (input: worldId, query parameters by name, a parsed JSON body) -> the request it must send (method, the expanded path, query, body: the JSON value to send or null for none), or the refusal (code, received) with no request at all. An absent body, null and {} all mean no body. row: the published openapi/operations.json row this file is about (method, path, pathParameters, queryParameters, auth, verdict) plus what a request may carry (body, bodyMembers) and whether contentWriteFindings admits it, with the reason; a test holds row to the stamped table and to the vendored contract. cases: no response cases yet (the docks' readers of these answers are the engines' own; none is in core). Reference: src/editor/dock-operations.ts dockOperationRequest, run by src/editor/__tests__/dock-operations.test.ts.

contentWrite.why: A read: a GET, not named as a write and on no entity collection, so contentWriteFindings finds nothing, and it writes nothing.
